feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 2 June 2026 4:40pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 02 June 2026 at 4:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds tomorrow.


##Synopsis##

Complex areas of low pressure around and to the west of Britain, with a weather front crossing the Irish Sea tomorrow.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 3 or 4, increasing West 4 occasionally 5 later this evening or at first tonight. Backing South 4 or 5 towards the end of the night, then backing and increasing Southeast 5 or 6 tomorrow morning. Veering Southwest 5 or 6 late morning or early afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Scattered showers, rain for a time tomorrow morning, showers again in afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers or rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest veering West 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in a few placesfor a time Wednesday night. Veering west Thursday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate Wednesday evening, occasionally rough Wednesday night.


##Weather##

Rain clearing to scattered showers Wednesday afternoon, these merging into longer outbreaks of rain overnight into Thursday for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or showers.
